name: p0-hardening
title: P0 hardening: shell stability, honest readings, write amplification and pipe exposure
description: Implement the four P0 items of the BrightTray audit (artifacts/brighttray-fork-notes.md): P0-01 stop terminating ShellHost, P0-03 remove the fake 100 percent fallback, P0-04 reduce DDC write amplification, P0-02 restrict the pipe and rate limit writes. Unit tests (P1-01) are explicitly out of scope for now.
